main_text.p: one Christi in coelos cofenfum unà nobi-fcu adprobantis, teftimoniu infpicere,le-gat Philippi Melanchthonis poftrema in cap.3.Epiftolęad[?] Colloffenfes[?] Enarratio ne. Sed iam ad inftitutu de cotrouerfijs quae funt de bonis operibus, accedamus.

¶ Exiftimo mei effe officij,fontes praecipuarũ controuerfiarũ inter noftras Ec-clefias & Pontificios, uelut exerto digito comonftrare,ut quo ordine praecipua fo-phismata nobis diftribueda,& quo pacto dijudicanda fint, intelligamus. Breuiter itaq; treis nobiles quaeftiones, de origi-ne,fpeciebus & utilitate bonorū operū, proponā,ac de ijs ordine & logicè agam.
1. De efficientibus caufsis; An'ne gra-tiae & liberi arbitrij concurfus opera bo-na producat,nécnè?
2. De forma : An'ne praeter ea bona opera,quae Deus praefcripfit,alia quoq; effe poffint hoc nomine digna?
3. De finibus:An'ne,fi negetur iuftifica-tio operum bonorum haec, fructu carere, eoq; negligi poffe,fit exiftimandum?

head.i: De prima quaestione, in qua agitur de bonorum operum origine,

main_text.p: Vt haec quaestio,An'ne liberi arbitrij & gratiae

page.notes: Page number "310" is printed in old style ("3ıo") and is read with doubt. Doubtful readings: "Epiftolęad" and "Colloffenfes" (the scan is faint at the ligatures). The line "one Christi" begins mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. The last line "gratiae" is set right-aligned and continues onto the next page.
